dedupe_keys.name: monitoring data for railway bridge kw51 in leuven belgium before during and after retrofitting

description: A KU Leuven team publishes fifteen months of measurements from the KW51 steel bowstring railway bridge. Zenodo supplies monthly ambient-vibration and train-passage archives, tracked modal properties, MATLAB functions and a short readme under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Sensors measured deck and arch acceleration, strain in bridge members and rails, bearing displacement, temperature and humidity before, during and after diagonal-connection strengthening. The schedule includes two train passages and six ambient-vibration periods per day. These measurements can calibrate structural-health and retrofit-effect simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this longitudinal bridge record. Coverage is one Leuven bridge and its intervention period, not a general rail-bridge deterioration curve. A limitation is that traffic, weather and sensor changes may also affect modal estimates; the retrofit effect was not isolated here. No data archive was downloaded or signal reprocessed.
